IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:
Monday 9 November
Winds: Variable about 10 knots becoming east to northeasterly 15 to 20 knots in the middle of the day then tending north to northeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the late evening.
Seas: Below 0.5 metres, increasing to around 1 metre around midday.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Tuesday 10 November
Winds: North to northwesterly about 10 knots tending southeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the middle of the day then turning southwesterly in the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Mostly sunny morning. 60% chance of showers in the late afternoon and evening.

Wednesday 11 November
Winds: Southwesterly 15 to 20 knots turning west to northwesterly below 10 knots during the evening.
Seas: Around 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Thursday 12 November
Winds: Northwesterly below 10 knots tending southeasterly 15 to 20 knots during the day then tending southerly 10 to 15 knots during the evening.
Seas: Below 0.5 metres, increasing to around 1 metre during the afternoon.
Weather: Partly cloudy.
IDT12420.synoptic: A high pressure system will drift away to the southeast today. A trough is expected to move over from the west on Tuesday evening, closely followed by a ridge on Wednesday. The ridge is forecast to remain over Tasmania on Thursday.

IDT12326.name: South East Coast
IDT12326.text:
Monday 9 November
Winds: Northeasterly about 10 knots increasing to 15 to 20 knots in the morning.
Seas: Below 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres during the afternoon.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 3 metres.
Weather: Cloudy.

Tuesday 10 November
Winds: Northwest to northeasterly 15 to 20 knots becoming west to northwesterly about 10 knots in the morning then tending west to southwesterly 15 to 20 knots in the early afternoon.
Seas: 1 to 1.5 metres, decreasing to 1 metre during the morning, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres inshore by early evening.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 2.5 metres.
Swell: Easterly around 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres during the morning.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 70% chance of showers.

Wednesday 11 November
Winds: Southwesterly 15 to 20 knots turning westerly 20 to 30 knots during the day.
Seas: 1 to 1.5 metres, increasing to 1.5 to 2.5 metres during the morning.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 2.5 metres.
Swell: Easterly 1 to 1.5 metres, decreasing to around 1 metre during the morning.
Weather: Cloudy.
IDT12326.synoptic: A high pressure system will drift away to the southeast today. A trough is expected to move over from the west on Tuesday evening, closely followed by a ridge on Wednesday. The ridge is forecast to remain over Tasmania on Thursday.
